desc:
Welcome to Survive LAVA for Lucky Blocks! 🍀

1. Jump on rocks and avoid the lava! 🔥
2. Collect Lucky Blocks before the lava gets you! 🍀
3. Open your luckyblocks and get a ton of brainrots! 💸
4. Upgrade brainrots, expand your plot and place even more Brainrots! 🏗️

⏰ REMEMBER: Your Brainrots Earn Money OFFLINE! 🤑

If you like the game, make sure to leave a like! 👍
